target.statement: F1-score of 0.817 ± 0.007 for the Two-Phase (Ours) method on the DataCo dataset with 10% labeled data (10-fold CV)

compute.basis: Paper reports ~143s training time on a free Colab CPU (12.7GB RAM) for the full pipeline; 10-fold CV with nested grid search over 16 SVM hyperparameter combos and up to 10 self-training iterations per fold, plus data download and preprocessing, should fit in a few hours on a laptop CPU.

blockers: Colab notebook link may be stale or incomplete (no GitHub repo, no explicit configs)
Exact preprocessing details (target encoding, imputation) are described but not provided as code, so reimplementation may not exactly match the reported 0.817
DataCo dataset requires manual download from Mendeley Data (free but not scripted)
title: Semi-Supervised Supply Chain Fraud Detection with Unsupervised Pre-Filtering
